info.title: DroppedNeedle v3
info.description: Native API contract. Generated clients must never be hand-edited.

get.summary: Every live app password across users, with owners.

post.summary:
Import a batch of accounts from one provider. The catalog is re-read
server-side; unknown, already-bound, and failed uids land in `skipped`.

get.summary:
List Jellyfin accounts available for import. Honest 503 until the live
Jellyfin client lands (same posture as the login flows).

List Plex accounts available for import. Honest 503 until the live Plex
client lands (same posture as the login flows).

post.summary: Create a local account.
Mint a recovery code for one user. The code returns once.

delete.summary: Revoke every session of one user.

post.summary: Mint a named companion Bearer [REDACTED] Standard sessions only.

Jellyfin login: checks credentials against the configured server, imports
the user, and mints a session. Transport rule matches local login.

200.description: Authenticated user; token only in Bearer [REDACTED]

post.summary:
Local login. Cookie mode (default) sets the session cookie and the body
carries no token; Bearer mode returns the raw token once and sets no
cookie. Failures are one uniform 401 with a dummy-hash verify behind it.

200.description: Authenticated user; token only in Bearer mode

schema.description:
Login/setup success body: the authenticated user, plus the raw session
token only in Bearer mode (cookie mode carries it in `Set-Cookie`).

token.description: Raw session token; present only in Bearer mode.

post.summary:
Logout. Public so a stale client can always clear its cookie: revokes the
presented token when it resolves, always clears the cookie, always 204.
Revoke every own session.
Start an OIDC login: returns the browser URL (PKCE + state baked in).

get.summary:
OIDC callback: consumes the IdP code/state and redirects (relative
Location, same-site hand-off, v2 parity) to the SPA callback carrying the
one-time exchange code. Always `no-store`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State echoed from the authorize step

302.description: Redirect to the SPA callback with the exchange code

200.description: Authenticated user; token only in Bearer [REDACTED]

post.summary:
Reset a password with a recovery code. Public: a locked-out user holds
no session.

Plex settings completion: polls the PIN and returns the raw auth token
untouched. Requires a session (the token is an account credential).

200.description: Pending flag, or the raw auth token

post.summary:
Plex link completion: polls the PIN and returns the verified profile.
Requires a session (the profile carries account tokens); no login side
effects, the caller attaches the profile to its own account.

200.description: Pending flag, or the verified profile

post.summary:
Plex login completion: polls the PIN, and once authorized imports the
user and mints a session. Pending polls carry only the flag.

200.description: Pending flag, or the user once authorized

post.summary:
Start any Plex flow: mints a PIN and its browser URL. Link and connect
starts 400 without a configured Plex server; login starts never gate.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: Which flow this PIN serves: login (default), link, or connect

400.description: Link/connect start without a configured Plex server

get.summary: List the caller's sessions for the R6 UI.

post.summary:
First-admin setup. Creates the admin and logs them in (201 + session,
v2 parity) iff no users exist; otherwise 409. Concurrent setups serialize
on the state guard: the loser probes after the winner commits and lands
on 409. (The users slice has no empty-table constraint, so without the
guard two distinct usernames would both succeed.)

201.description: First admin created and logged in

schema.description:
Login/setup success body: the authenticated user, plus the raw session
token only in Bearer mode (cookie mode carries it in `Set-Cookie`).

token.description: Raw session token; present only in Bearer mode.

get.summary: Setup-required probe for the SPA first-run gate.

post.summary: Create an app password. The secret returns once.
Upload a new avatar from base64 bytes.

put.summary: Store the caller's own Last.fm API credentials.

post.summary: Exchange an approved token for a linked session.
Fetch a Last.fm sign-in token plus approval URL.

put.summary: Set or clear the caller's email.

post.summary: Set the first local password on an account without one.
Change the caller's password.

get.summary: Serve one user's avatar. Self-or-admin; the `v` query is ignored.

AdminAppPasswordListResponse.description: Every active app password across users.

app_passwords.description: Active app passwords, by owner then age.

AdminAppPasswordView.description: One app password with its owner, for admin oversight.

last_client.description: Client label from the last verification, when sent.

display_name.description: Display name; defaults to the username casing.

AppPasswordCreatedResponse.description: A created app password. The secret appears here once, never again.

AppPasswordView.description: One app password, without secret material.

last_client.description: Client label from the last verification, when sent.

AvatarUpload.description:
Avatar upload. JSON with base64 bytes: the server has no multipart
support, and one JSON shape keeps every client on the same parser.

image_base64.description: Base64 image bytes, at most 5 MiB decoded.

AvatarUploadBody.description: Avatar upload payload (parsed manually so the body cap applies).

label.description: Device label, 1-80 chars. Reminting a label revokes the prior token.

DeviceSessionResponse.description: A minted companion token. The raw token appears here once, never again.

display_name.description: New display name, 1-64 chars after trimming.

EmailUpdate.description: Change email. Null or blank clears it.

email.description: New email, or null to clear.

ErrorBody.description: The `error` object inside every error response.

details.description: Extra detail, or null when there is none.

message.description: Human message. Fixed for 5xx, descriptive for 4xx.

FederatedUserView.description:
Authenticated user, federated view. Stored provider rows never surface;
only the profile fields the SPA renders.

email.description: Lowercased email, when the provider supplies one.

HealthResponse.description: Health payload. Shape kept from v2: `status` plus the running message.

ImportCandidateView.description:
One media-server account offered for import. Display only: the import
re-reads the directory server-side and never trusts echoed fields.

already_imported.description: True when a binding for this `(provider, provider_uid)` exists.

avatar_url.description: Account image URL, when the provider exposes one.

email.description: Account email, when the provider exposes one.

provider_uid.description: Provider-side id (Jellyfin user id, Plex account uuid).

ImportUsersRequest.description: Import a batch of accounts from one provider.

provider_uids.description: Provider uids to import, matched against a fresh directory listing.

imported.description: Newly created accounts, in request order.

linked.description: Existing accounts the provider was linked to (email match).

skipped.description: Uids skipped: unknown, already bound, or failed.

total_imported.description: Count of `imported`, for the admin summary line.

configured.description: Always true when this response is returned.

linked.description: Whether a session is still linked (a key change unlinks).

LastFmCredentialsSet.description:
Store per-user Last.fm API credentials. Either field may be the
`lastfm****` mask sentinel, meaning keep the stored value.

api_key.description: Last.fm API key, or the mask sentinel to keep it.

shared_secret.description: Last.fm shared secret, or the mask sentinel to keep it.

LastFmSessionExchange.description: Exchange an approved token for a session.

token.description: The token from the token step, after browser approval.

linked.description: Always true when this response is returned.

LastFmStatusResponse.description: Per-user Last.fm link status. Never carries secrets.

LastFmTokenResponse.description: A Last.fm sign-in token plus the URL to approve it at.

auth_url.description: Approval URL to open in a browser.

token.description: Single-use token for the session exchange.

LocalPasswordSet.description: Set the first local password on an account without one.

OidcAuthorizeBody.description: OIDC authorize answer: the browser URL for this login.

authorize_url.description: IdP authorize URL (PKCE + state baked in).

state.description: State echoed from the authorize step.

OidcExchangeBody.description: OIDC exchange body: swap the one-time callback code for a session.

code.description: Single-use code from the callback redirect.

PasswordChange.description: Change password on an account that already has one.

PasswordReset.description: Public password reset with a recovery code.

recovery_code.description: Recovery code from the admin (dashes and case ignored).

PlexConnectPollResult.description: Settings-completion poll answer: the raw auth token, untouched.

completed.description: True once the user authorized the PIN.
True once the user authorized the PIN.

pin_id.description: PIN id from the start step.

PlexLoginPollResult.description:
Login-completion poll answer. Pending carries only the flag; a completed
poll carries the user (plus the token in Bearer [REDACTED] the session cookie
in cookie mode, like every login).

completed.description: True once the user authorized the PIN.

token.description: Present only when completed in Bearer [REDACTED]

pin_id.description: PIN id from the start step.

PlexProfileView.description:
Verified Plex profile for the link flow. No login side effects; the
caller attaches it to its account on an authenticated route.

email.description: Account email; empty when the API omits it.

server_access_token.description: Server-scoped token; empty when no server is configured.

pin_id.description: PIN id for the poll steps.

ProfileResponse.description:
Own profile. Identity only; connected services and library stats belong
to the connections and library slices.

RecoveryCodeResponse.description: A minted recovery code. The code appears here once, never again.

Role.description:
Account role. Meanings are unchanged from v2: `user` requests await
approval; `trusted` and `admin` auto-approve and are quota-exempt.

SessionView.description: One session row for the sessions UI.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

label.description: Companion device name, or the browser user agent.

SetupBody.description: First-admin setup body. Runs only against an empty user table.

display_name.description: Display name; defaults to the username casing.

SetupStatusBody.description: Setup-required probe for the SPA first-run gate.

setup_required.description: True when no users exist yet and setup must run.

TransportDto.description:
Credential handoff for session-issuing routes. Mirrors the sibling
`TransportParam` (which owns the mechanism) so this layer stays the only
place that needs `ToSchema`.

avatar_url.description: Served avatar URL, when an avatar is set.

username.description: New username: 3-32 chars of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`.
